title: Vista Gold Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Corporate Update
summary: DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Vista Gold Corp. (NYSE American and TSX: VGZ) today announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30,
body_markdown:
DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Vista Gold Corp. (NYSE American and TSX: VGZ) today announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with cash totaling $43.5 million at quarter-end. All dollar amounts in this press release are in U.S. dollars.


Frederick H. Earnest, President and CEO of Vista Gold, stated, “During the third quarter, we maintained strong progress in advancing the Mt Todd gold project toward development. Key achievements included continued progress on permitting activities, strengthening our Australian-based leadership team, and advancing technical optimization initiatives.”


On September 20, 2026, Vista entered into an arrangement agreement (the “Arrangement Agreement”) with Artemis Gold Inc. (TSXV: ARTG) (“Artemis”), pursuant to which Artemis agreed to acquire all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Vista by way of a court-approved plan of arrangement under the *Business Corporations Act* (British Columbia) (the “Arrangement”).


Under the terms of the Arrangement, each outstanding common share of Vista, other than shares held by dissenting shareholders and Artemis and its affiliates as provided in the Arrangement Agreement, will be exchanged for 0.0966 of an Artemis common share, subject to the terms of the Arrangement Agreement and the Arrangement. Upon completion of the Arrangement, Vista will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Artemis, and Vista’s shareholders immediately prior to completion are expected to collectively own approximately 5%1 of Artemis’ shares.


Mr. Earnest commented, “We are confident that the transaction with Artemis represents a compelling opportunity to deliver value to our shareholders now and over the long term. In addition to providing an immediate premium to the market price of Vista shares, the Arrangement offers shareholders the opportunity to benefit from the ongoing expansion of the Blackwater operation and the potential development of Mt Todd as part of a larger, well-capitalized gold producer. We believe Artemis brings the scale, experience and resources to develop Mt Todd and realize its full potential. This transaction represents an important opportunity to realize the substantial value of Mt Todd while becoming part of an established and growing intermediate gold producer.”


While the Arrangement is pending, Vista continues to conduct its business in the ordinary course, including activities related to the advancement of the Mt Todd gold project, subject to the covenants and restrictions set forth in the Arrangement Agreement. If the Arrangement is not completed, the Company will continue to operate as an independent public company and will continue to seek to maximize shareholder value through advancement of its Mt Todd gold project.


Additional information regarding the Arrangement, including its terms, conditions, termination provisions and the interests of certain directors and executive officers, is included in the Company’s preliminary proxy statement dated October 19, 2026, filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) and the Canadian securities regulatory authorities and can be accessed on Vista’s issuer profile on EDGAR at[www.sec.gov](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov&esheet=54639873&newsitemid=20261111156716&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sec.gov&index=1&md5=8e6958c3fa980d92d8f7d9cada5c718a) and SEDAR+ at[www.sedarplus.ca](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sedarplus.ca&esheet=54639873&newsitemid=20261111156716&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sedarplus.ca&index=2&md5=973087070ae870ffb6d5abb70f655af9) . The definitive proxy statement is expected to be filed in the coming weeks.


**Summary of Financial Results**


Vista reported a consolidated net loss of $6.4 million, or $0.05 per common share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a consolidated net loss of $0.7 million, or $0.01 per common share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2025.


Cash and cash equivalents totaled $43.5 million at September 30, 2026, compared to $13.6 million at December 31, 2025. Vista continued to have no debt.

**About Vista Gold Corp.**


Vista Gold holds the Mt Todd gold project, a development-stage gold deposit located in the favorable mining jurisdiction of Northern Territory, Australia. Mt Todd offers a large gold mineral reserve with development optionality, expansion opportunities, and exploration upside. With advanced local infrastructure, strong community support, and demonstrated economic feasibility, Mt Todd has the potential to become a long-lived, globally significant gold operation. For more information visit[www.vistagold.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.vistagold.com&esheet=54639873&newsitemid=20261111156716&lan=en-US&anchor=www.vistagold.com&index=4&md5=5b3440ef3524323f2b59737d8fdc0212) .
